reason: Adds struct fields; they back three newly registered metrics exposed by the new CompactSelectedSeries public API.
headline: dbMetrics gains counters and histogram for selected-series compactions
summary: Three fields are added to the unexported dbMetrics struct (selectedSeriesCompactionsTriggered, selectedSeriesCompactionsFailed, selectedSeriesCompactionDuration); the rest of the diff is gofmt realignment. newDBMetrics initializes and registers them, and CompactSelectedSeries updates them, so they add three new series to /metrics output.
focus: new metric names prometheus_tsdb_selected_series_compaction(s)_* do not collide with existing registrations, since MustRegister panics on a duplicate
every new field is initialized in newDBMetrics before CompactSelectedSeries dereferences it, including when the registerer r is nil
